scientific.integrity: The arbitrary-parameter statement is proved symbolically. Exact finite-field calculations are supplied only as finite consistency checks and are not used as evidence for the infinite theorem.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is for primitive polynomial cores and for the canonical exterior-degree annihilator; it does not assert equality with every specialized scalar minimal recurrence, and it does not cover merely irreducible nonprimitive cores.

title: Constant-weight necklace factorization of primitive-core Toeplitz recurrence polynomials
